data.title: Festival Opens at Uyun Al-Jiwa Heritage Village
data.content:
Uyun Al-Jiwa, November 22, 2026, SPA -- A nine-day festival began at the heritage village in Uyun Al-Jiwa Governorate, organized by Qassim Region Municipality through Uyun Al-Jiwa Municipality in cooperation with the governorate's local development association.
    The festival aims to preserve folk heritage, promote community participation, and support families working in the cottage industry and owners of local initiatives.
    Head of Uyun Al-Jiwa Municipality Eng. Falah bin Jabr Al-Jabreen said heritage events highlight national identity and recall the community's customs, traditions, and authentic values, giving new generations a chance to learn about the past.
    The festival features the Saudi Ardah, a traditional wedding re-enactment, entertainment troupes, a children’s stage, and products from participating families.
    
    -- SPA
